## Summary

What changes and why. Link the issue it addresses, if any.

## Testing

Commands you ran (for example `bash scripts/build-app.sh`, `scripts/check-localization.py`) and manual steps, including the site (YouTube or YouTube Music) and macOS version. Say what you could not test.

## Checklist

- [ ] Stays within the [project scope](https://github.com/ghufronakbar/ririku/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#project-scope); no new dependencies, permissions, or network destinations without explanation
- [ ] Interface text is English in code, with `id` and `ja` translations added (`scripts/check-localization.py` passes)
- [ ] User-facing changes are reflected in `docs/user-guide.md` (and translations, or noted as pending) and `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] Product decisions changed? Added a dated entry to `docs/decisions.md`
- [ ] Screenshots attached for visible UI changes
